label: Italian Card Slot
description: The Italian card slot is a minimalist horizontal slit — barely more than a scored line in the cloth — positioned just above the right hip pocket, sized precisely to accept a business card or folded ticket without any welt, flap, or jet dressing the opening. Associated with clean-lined Italian ready-to-wear and bespoke tailoring in the Milanese tradition, it gives the jacket a modern, graphic quality where the pocket reads as a deliberate incision rather than an ornamental feature. Its restraint makes it especially appropriate on slim, structured city suits in fine worsted.
